messages:
anna_partnerships: Heads-up — PartnerCloud wants us to onboard a private VPC in ap-southeast4 (Southeast Asia) for their first wave of customers. Target launch window: 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-22. Need quotas, entitlements, KMS access, and a final handoff doc. Link to draft runbook: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/ap-southeast4-partnercloud

jake_partnereng: Thanks Anna. Can you confirm required GPU SKUs + expected concurrency? I'll pre-check PartnerCloud's marketplace entitlement mapping.

anna_partnerships: Initial ask from PartnerCloud: 8x A10G equiv nodes for dedicated pools, plus 2x burst nodes. Expected steady qps ~1200 requests/min, spiky up to 3500/min during peak. They want VPC peering + private control plane.

priya_se: Adding SE checklist: networking CIDR, route tables, allowed egress CIDRs for telemetry, and who will manage VPN termination. Also need sample terraform for the peering (can share our template).

matt_ops: @jake_partnereng i'll run a capacity check this afternoon. Do we have a quota request id to attach to the cloud marketplace ticket?

jake_partnereng: Not yet — i'll open the entitlement ticket with PartnerCloud legal and ops after we confirm SKUs. Will include a request for quota escalation to the marketplace team (internal ticket: MP-4719).

li_legal: FYI legal needs the Data Processing Addendum + KMS flow documented. For private VPC we require a signed SOC2 addendum and explicit KMS key usage policy. Can PartnerCloud sign our standard addendum or do they need redlines?

nina_cs: PartnerCloud said they'd sign standard terms but asked about key management options (bring-your-own-key vs our managed KMS). Which is acceptable for private?

anna_partnerships: Preference is BYOK for enterprises; PartnerCloud requested our managed KMS initially. @li_legal can approve managed KMS for PartnerCloud if they complete attestation?

li_legal: Managed KMS ok if they pass attestation and we get an export-restriction agreement. I'll draft the attestation checklist.

kelly_sales: Sales note: PartnerCloud is planning a joint announcement for their APAC launch, want 2–3 weeks of runway after GA. We should gate the public announcement until entitlements + capacity validated.

jake_partnereng: Quick technical note — our private control plane will need the following firewall ports open: 443, 2200 (ssh), 9411 (tracing). Also we prefer mTLS for control plane endpoints. I'll post a minimal config snippet: ```
# peering example
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "pc_ap_sea" {
  local_vpc_cidr = "10.40.0.0/16"
  peer_vpc_cidr  = "10.50.0.0/16"
  control_plane_tls = "mTLS"
}
```

matt_ops: Got it. I'll pre-create the capacity pool and reserve 6 nodes for canary traffic. Will annotate the infra ticket with node IDs once provisioned (INFRA-2302).

anna_partnerships: Action items: 1) @jake_partnereng open entitlement ticket + quota request (MP-4719). 2) @matt_ops pre-provision 6 nodes for canary (INFRA-2302). 3) @li_legal draft attestation & confirm KMS flow. 4) @priya_se prepare peering terraform + test plan. 5) @nina_cs coordinate partner comms & announcement runway. I'll update the handoff doc with timelines.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please add the GA date to the deploy calendar: /deploy schedule add "PartnerCloud ap-southeast4 GA" 2026-04-22 09:00 Asia/Singapore

jake_partnereng: Done — ticket MP-4719 opened and linked to the draft handoff: https://redwood.internal/tickets/MP-4719. Quota request attached (requested +10 A10G equiv nodes).

matt_ops: Pre-provision started, creating vpool pc-ap-sea-canary, ETA ~6 hours. Will share node hostnames when ready.

priya_se: Terraform + test plan uploaded to the runbook. Test checklist includes: end-to-end provisioning, peering validation (latency + packet drops), access control, and failover to fallback region.

li_legal: Draft attestation uploaded, requesting review by security. Also added KMS usage policy.

nina_cs: PartnerCloud replied: OK to sign standard T&Cs, request managed KMS for now and will evaluate BYOK later. They asked for a short technical integration session next Tue.

anna_partnerships: Scheduling integration call: Tue 2026-03-10 09:30 SGT. Agenda: entitlements, peering, KMS, rollout plan, announcement runway. I'll send calendar invite. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

kelly_sales: I'll draft joint announcement copy once we confirm GA window. Please flag any embargo or legal constraints.

anna_partnerships: Thanks team — i'll close action items in the handoff doc as we get updates. Will ping again when nodes are live.
